$comment: Tyn nad Vltavou (South Bohemia), traced by hand-tooling from a rendered map picture (D-1: no OSM data import), turned 135 deg so the north-east fields face WEST. Terrain-local metres, SW corner 0,0, x east, y north; 4000 x 3500 m. Transform: L = (2118, 1900) + R(+135 deg) . ((px-500) m, -(py-560) m) with m = 3.12 m/px on the z15 picture (tiles x 17695.., y 11220..) — the old town sits east of the middle. Format beyond the CE-6001 plan (CE-6020): sizeYMetres, areas (kind + polygon), slabs, landmarks, square, labels (sketch only); a bridge's name is a note.
